audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Renekton six of seven rows while the whys underneath say the opposite in plain words: whys[1] ends 'keeping it genuinely even', whys[2] 'comes down to whose CC lands first', whys[3] 'read-dependent', whys[4] 'giving her the 6 edge', whys[5] describes her Trinity Force spike, whys[6] 'neither kit has a decisive scaling edge'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Renekton, Skill, Skill, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Skill and the mirror (irelia__renekton) flipped rows 1-6 to it as matched pairs, rating even rows 5/10 and Irelia rows 7/10.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped in matched full/content pairs; ratings 5/5/5 for the even stages, 3/3 for hers, 5 for the last row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The First-item row credited your Eclipse; spikes[3] and whys[5] both say Trinity Force is the item that decides that window.
audit.why: Sheen-line burst on short cooldowns out-paces your Q sustain.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to match the prose already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defiant Dance never appears anywhere on the page, yet it is the direct counter to your combo: she takes reduced physical damage while charging it, so an empowered W dumped into the hold is wasted. Flawless Duet was described only as 'her engage CC' with no mention that it stuns only enemies caught between the two converging blades, and no cooldown. wants.foe[0] claims stacking Ionian Fervor nullifies your armour — the passive grants stacking attack speed and, at max stacks, bonus on-hit damage; there is no shred.
audit.why: Irelia W: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge', 20/18/16/14/12. E: 'sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked', 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. P: 'stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.'
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance stated in report[5].t; the between-the-blades condition and 16s cooldown in dosFull[0].d; the interrupt in dontsFull[0].d; Bladesurge's reset condition in dontsFull[1].d; the passive corrected in wants.foe[0] and in the early block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Executioner's Calling was justified as 'his healing' with no source and the wrong pronoun.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every dash and refreshes on marked or dying targets, so the anti-heal is aimed at a 6s-cooldown reset tool.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Flawless Duet's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A pushed wave is her playground — Bladesurge resets through minions dodge your stun, so freeze and make her step up alone.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Flawless Duet's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Trinity Force outpaces your Eclipse — from here, trade only with Dominus banked.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Irelia carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Neither kit runs away with it — you threaten towers fast, she threatens solo kills in a wave. Press your map lead first.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Flawless Duet stuns only between the two blades — 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Irelia's Flawless Duet (Stun): Her engage CC. Bait it. When it is down — W-stun + Q her.
edits.after: Defiant Dance cuts physical damage while she charges it — never dump empowered W into the hold.

edits.before: That is Irelia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Flawless Duet interrupts your W mid-slash — bait it with a Q step-up first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bladesurge refreshes on marked or dying minions — she surfs the wave.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse  (burst + the early bully curve), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse (burst + the early bully curve), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — Bladesurge heals her every dash.

edits.before: Stack her passive (Ionian Fervor) on minions to get max shred before a all-in so your armor is nullified
edits.after: Stack Ionian Fervor on minions before the all-in so she arrives at max attack speed with bonus on-hit damage

edits.before: At level 1 Irelia has no reliable gap-close — her Bladesurge (Q) is weak without reset targets and she has no CC. Auto-trade into her freely and bank 50 Fury before the wave grows. The moment you hit level 2 flip the script: E through her, empowered W-stun, Q-heal, then E back out. She cannot answer that before she has Flawless Duet (E). Watch for her trying to stack passive (Ionian Fervor) on minions before stepping up — if you see her walking through casters, that is her baiting you into a shred trade; trade BEFORE she gets 5 stacks or back off and reset the wave.
edits.after: At level 1 Irelia has no reliable gap-close — her Bladesurge (Q) is weak without reset targets and she has no CC. Auto-trade into her freely and bank 50 Fury before the wave grows. The moment you hit level 2 flip the script: E through her, empowered W-stun, Q-heal, then E back out. She cannot answer that before she has Flawless Duet (E), which is 16s at rank 1. Watch her stacking Ionian Fervor on minions before she steps up — walking through casters is her loading attack speed and the max-stack on-hit damage; trade BEFORE it caps, or reset the wave.

notes: The whys on this page were already correct and the chart contradicted them on six rows — a reader following the chart would take exactly the fights the prose warns against. Defiant Dance was the missing interaction worth the most: it is a physical damage reduction charged in your face, and the page never mentioned the ability at all. Mirror flagged that Renekton's Q is misnamed 'Cull of the Meek' and his R described as a knock-up on the Irelia side; neither error appears in the fields on this page.
